name: ZONOS3-Mini (open-weight voice-cloning TTS, 43 languages)
summary: Zyphra's compact text-to-speech model (sparse MoE, ~100M active / ~800M total params): zero-shot voice cloning from a short clip, voice design by age/accent/texture, and word-level steering of emotion, pace and delivery, in 43 languages. Runs locally in real time, including in the browser via WebGPU; GGUF builds, SGLang-Omni serving and sample voices included. Useful for game voices, narration and dubbing.

access.price: $0; optional hosted API on Zyphra Cloud
access.notes: HF card license: apache-2.0, not gated. Code repo github.com/Zyphra/ZONOS3-Mini is MIT. Only clone voices you have consent for. Browser demo needs WebGPU.

procedure: Try it with no install in the browser: https://zyphra.com/zonos3-mini/localplayground/lite (WebGPU).
Or download the weights from https://huggingface.co/Zyphra/ZONOS3-Mini (GGUF backbone + codec).
Run locally with the runtimes in https://github.com/Zyphra/ZONOS3-Mini, or serve with SGLang-Omni: sgl-omni serve --model-path Zyphra/ZONOS3-Mini.

stats.size: ~30.7 GB full repo (300 files incl. GGUF variants and sample voices)

verdict.why: Strong open TTS for creators: Apache-2.0 weights (commercial OK), runs in-browser and on laptops, 43 languages, voice cloning and steerable delivery; 251 HF likes and 8.5K downloads in days, already ported to mlx-audio-swift. Vendor benchmarks not independently verified.
